name: @pipeup/agents
description: Lets an AI agent read and answer a page's comments: its replies file, the live link on this computer and the prompt for an agent.
author: Pipeup contributors

to: the replies file next to this page (this site or this computer)
the program running on this computer, when the page is shown with pipeup watch
network.says: Reads a replies file next to this page. When the page is shown through pipeup watch, and only after you switch it on, it sends this page's comments to the program running on this computer. Nothing leaves this computer.
